title: GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) cheat codes, sourced
confirmed_rule: Confirmed = the same input published by 2 or more reputable outlets (or by Rockstar). Anything else = TBC.

codes_published_so_far.note: 19 inputs confirmed by 2+ outlets in this file; GamesRadar+ (updated 20 Nov) lists the same 19; Gaming Route reports 19 of 61 as of 20 Nov.

unlock: Cheats only work after you finish the main story (Eurogamer, GameSpot, GamesRadar+, Polygon, PC Gamer, Dexerto). Each cheat also has its own challenge; progress made before the ending counts (GameSpot, Polygon, PC Gamer). Codes appear in Progress > Cheats once unlocked (Eurogamer, Polygon, GamesRadar+).
side_effects: Using a cheat disables saving and trophies/achievements for that session (Eurogamer, Polygon, GameSpot, GamesRadar+, PC Gamer).
rockstar_official: We found no cheat list published by Rockstar on its websites (checked 21 Nov 2026). The codes are shown in-game in the Progress > Cheats menu, which outlets screenshot (credited 'Rockstar').

how_to_enter.hold: Hold L1 + R1 (PS5) / LB + RB (Xbox) on the phone home screen
how_to_enter.button_notes: Eurogamer: 'hold both shoulder buttons'. GameSpot, GamesRadar+, Polygon: hold L1 + R1. Dexerto and PC Gamer word it 'hold L1 and press R1'. Polygon says it only tested PS5 and assumes LB + RB on Xbox.
